name: BridgeData V2
summary: BridgeData V2 contains over 60,000 trajectories across 24 environments on inexpensive WidowX arms, deliberately emphasizing environmental and object diversity rather than a single polished setup. Because the hardware is cheap and widely replicated, it became the de facto shared evaluation platform for open generalist policies.
innovation: Prioritized breadth of scenes and objects over demonstration polish or task count.
Built on affordable hardware other labs could reproduce, enabling genuinely comparable evaluation.
matters: One of the few settings where different labs' policies can be compared on a common physical platform.
limits: Low-cost arms have limited precision and payload, and it is single-arm only.
lineage: A foundational component dataset of Open X-Embodiment.
